title: A quest-linked dialogue option ('tell Halm what the Ironbound mean to do') stayed selectable on Prior Halm's menu across at least two separate visits after that exact questline (The Mission's Order) was already completed through a different NPC (Warder Iss at the Ironbound Mission), and even after Halm had independently thanked me for the drowned nave resting.
